title: First Ascent of Mont Blanc
details: The first recorded ascent of Mont Blanc marked the beginning of modern mountaineering and showed that the highest peaks of the Alps could be climbed.

title: Pioneering the Alps
details: The successful ascent helped establish mountaineering as a serious pursuit and encouraged further exploration of the Alps.

title: Matterhorn Conquered
details: The first ascent of the Matterhorn became one of the most famous achievements of the Golden Age of Alpinism.

title: Kangchenjunga Exploration
details: Early expeditions to Kangchenjunga helped expand knowledge of the great Himalayan peaks.

title: Annapurna First 8,000m Summit
details: Annapurna became the first 8,000-metre peak successfully climbed, opening a new chapter in high-altitude mountaineering.

title: Everest Reached
details: The successful Everest expedition became one of the defining achievements in mountaineering history.

title: Everest Without Oxygen
details: Messner and Habeler demonstrated that Everest could be climbed without supplemental oxygen.

title: Winter K2 Summit
details: K2 was finally climbed in winter by a Nepalese team, completing one of the last great challenges in high-altitude mountaineering.
